text: {"rules":[],"notes":"M.G.L. c. 186, § 12 only sets notice periods for ending an estate at will: three months' notice, or the rent-payment interval or 30 days if that is longer; and 14 days' notice to quit for nonpayment, with a 10-day right to cure and a required notice statement. It does not limit terminations to listed causes, so it is not a just-cause eviction rule. It states nothing on rent increase limits, security deposits, application or screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting. No in-scope rule is present."}
